Subject: Post-demo decision heatmap & procurement checkpoints

Hi Claire / Samuel —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our demo + a simple "decision heatmap" I sketched to surface who we think is likely to move the deal forward vs. influencers. I attached the heatmap and a short procurement checklist that maps Redwood's standard deliverables to common security/procurement requests.

Key takeaways from the demo (2/3 minute bullets):
- Value signal: 15–20% expected cost reduction on query workloads with similar latency compared to current on-prem GPUs (demo showed 1.2–1.4x throughput improvement).
- Primary use cases: customer support routing + policy-aware summarization; you flagged NLU latency under heavy load as the gating factor.
- Risk flags: legal asked about data residency and retention; security wanted SOC2 evidence and an SSO/KMS integration plan.

Decision heatmap (attached):
- Champion / Technical Lead: Samuel Ong (already positive)
- Economic buyer: Claire Zhou (you indicated finance will sign off)
- Security / Legal gatekeepers: Nebula Security team + Procurement (we'll need a short technical attest + questionnaire)

Open questions / asks for next week:
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer and the expected approval cadence? (we noted "end of June" on the call)
2) Please share the procurement contact & preferred contract template (if you have a procurement alias we should loop in).
3) Which security artifacts will move the needle fastest for you (SOC2 report, encryption attest, data flow diagram)?

Proposed next steps:
- I will send a short procurement checklist + pricing milestone worksheet by EOD today. (attached)
- If you confirm procurement contact, we can schedule a 30-min intake with Redwood Solutions + your procurement lead next week to align on milestones.

Attachments: decision_heatmap_nebula.png (png), procurement_checklist_nebula.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks — looking forward to consolidating the path to contract.

—
